mapper.select: SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, C.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm, A.AUTHOR_CD AS authorCd, A.AUTHOR_NM AS authorNm, A.AUTHOR_CN AS authorCn, A.USE_FL AS useFl, DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS creationDt FROM CM_AUTHOR A INNER JOIN CM_CMPNY C ON C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.AUTHOR_CD = #{authorCd}

SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, A.AUTHOR_CD AS authorCd, A.USER_TY AS userTy, A.USER_CD AS userCd, A.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, CASE WHEN A.USER_TY = 'USER' THEN CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN U.USER_ENG_NM ELSE U.USER_NM END WHEN A.USER_TY = 'GROUP' THEN CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN G.GROUP_ENG_NM ELSE G.GROUP_NM END ELSE '' END AS userNm, CASE WHEN A.USER_TY = 'USER' THEN DL.MESSAGE_CN ELSE '' END AS deptNm FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER A LEFT JOIN CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M ON A.USER_TY = 'USER' AND M.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND M.USE_FL = 'Y' AND CAST(M.MBRSH_SQ AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = TRIM(A.USER_CD) LEFT JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CM_DEPT D ON D.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND D.DEPT_CD = M.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG DL ON DL.LANG_KEY = D.DEPT_NM_KEY AND DL.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND DL.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} LEFT JOIN CM_GROUP G ON A.USER_TY = 'GROUP' AND G.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND G.GROUP_ID = A.USER_CD AND G.USE_FL = 'Y' WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.AUTHOR_CD = #{authorCd} ORDER BY A.SORT_ORD, A.USER_CD
SELECT CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, AUTHOR_CD AS authorCd, MENU_ID AS menuId, SORT_ORD AS sortOrd FROM CM_AUTHOR_MENU WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AUTHOR_CD = #{authorCd} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, MENU_ID

SELECT A.GROUP_ID AS groupId , CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN A.GROUP_ENG_NM ELSE A.GROUP_NM END AS groupNm FROM CM_GROUP A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y'
AND (A.GROUP_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR A.GROUP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR A.GROUP_ENG_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY A.GROUP_ID

SELECT A.GROUP_ID AS groupId , B.USER_ID AS userId , B.DEPT_CD AS deptCd , CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN C.USER_ENG_NM ELSE C.USER_NM END AS userNm , DL.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm FROM CM_GROUP_USER A INNER JOIN CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH B ON B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND B.MBRSH_SQ = A.MBRSH_SQ AND B.USE_FL = 'Y' INNER JOIN CM_USER C ON C.USER_ID = B.USER_ID INNER JOIN CM_DEPT D ON D.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND D.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG DL ON DL.LANG_KEY = D.DEPT_NM_KEY AND DL.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND DL.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND A.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY B.USER_ID

SELECT CAST(BASE.MBRSH_SQ AS CHAR) AS mbrshSq , BASE.USER_ID AS userId , BASE.USER_NM AS userNm , BASE.DEPT_CD AS deptCd , D.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm FROM ( SELECT A.MBRSH_SQ , A.USER_ID , CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN B.USER_ENG_NM ELSE B.USER_NM END AS USER_NM , A.DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , C.DEPT_NM_KEY , A.CMPNY_CD FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A INNER JOIN CM_USER B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CM_DEPT C ON A.DEPT_CD = C.DEPT_CD AND A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND A.DEPT_CD = #{deptCode} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ) BASE LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG D ON D.LANG_KEY = BASE.DEPT_NM_KEY AND D.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND D.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} ORDER BY BASE.USER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_AUTHOR ( CMPNY_CD, AUTHOR_CD, AUTHOR_NM, AUTHOR_CN, USE_FL, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{authorCd}, #{authorNm}, IFNULL(#{authorCn}, ''), IFNULL(#{useFl}, 'Y'), #{creationId}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO CM_AUTHOR_MENU ( CMPNY_CD, AUTHOR_CD, MENU_ID, SORT_ORD, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{authorCd}, #{menuId}, #{sortOrd}, #{creationId}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO CM_AUTHOR_USER ( CMPNY_CD, AUTHOR_CD, USER_TY, USER_CD, SORT_ORD, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{authorCd}, #{userTy}, #{userCd}, #{sortOrd}, #{creationId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_AUTHOR SET AUTHOR_NM = #{authorNm}, AUTHOR_CN = #{authorCn}, USE_FL = #{useFl}, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AUTHOR_CD = #{authorCd}
mapper.select: SELECT CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , UPPER_AUTHOR_CD AS upperAuthorCd , LOWER_AUTHOR_CD AS lowerAuthorCd FROM CM_AUTHOR_HIERSTRCT WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY UPPER_AUTHOR_CD, LOWER_AUTHOR_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_AUTHOR_HIERSTRCT (CMPNY_CD, UPPER_AUTHOR_CD, LOWER_AUTHOR_CD, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT) VALUES (#{cmpnyCd}, #{upperAuthorCd}, #{lowerAuthorCd}, #{creationId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , C.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , A.AUTHOR_CD AS authorCd , A.AUTHOR_NM AS authorNm , A.AUTHOR_CN AS authorCn , A.USE_FL AS useFl , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS creationDt FROM CM_AUTHOR A INNER JOIN CM_CMPNY C ON C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND C.USE_FL = 'Y' WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' AND A.AUTHOR_CD NOT IN ('SYS_ADMIN') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CM_AUTHOR_HIERSTRCT H WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND H.LOWER_AUTHOR_CD = A.AUTHOR_CD ) ORDER BY A.AUTHOR_CD

SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , C.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , A.AUTHOR_CD AS authorCd , A.AUTHOR_NM AS authorNm , A.AUTHOR_CN AS authorCn , A.USE_FL AS useFl , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS creationDt FROM CM_AUTHOR A INNER JOIN CM_CMPNY C ON C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND C.USE_FL = 'Y' WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y'
AND A.AUTHOR_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY A.AUTHOR_CD
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CM_AUTHOR_MENU WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AUTHOR_CD = #{authorCd}
DELETE FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AUTHOR_CD = #{authorCd}
